description: Calculate the exact volume of a solid generated by revolving a region bounded between two continuous functions y = f(x) and y = g(x) over [a, b] around the y-axis using V = \int_a^b 2*pi*x*(f(x) - g(x)) dx.
evidence: Identifies upper and lower bounding functions to formulate shell height h(x) = f(x) - g(x) and evaluates the resulting integral.
